verdict.rationale: Rootly's escalation policies define how it notifies responders. Pages can also be delivered and acknowledged in Microsoft Teams, and a truncated mention of an iOS/Android on-call mobile app hints at push delivery. Nothing in the pack documents SMS, outbound phone-call, or email paging, or user-configurable per-channel notification rules. Live Call Routing covers inbound calls only, not outbound paging channels. missing for 10: documented SMS paging, outbound voice-call paging, email paging, explicit push-notification docs, per-user per-channel notification rules, independent corroboration.
